qualityGates: Texas county containment against the authoritative 254-county geometry registry.
Coordinate sanity bounds and outlier review before routing, Route Watch, or notification use.
Brand normalization for punctuation/case aliases such as H-E-B/HEB, Buc-ee's/Bucees, Pilot/Flying J, Lowe's/Lowes, and Home Depot.
Duplicate resolution by source stable ID, normalized name, address, brand, category, and proximity.
Closed-location handling from source status fields, commercial lifecycle data, and manual suppression lists.
Sensitive-public-safety and critical-infrastructure review to prevent consumer-hostile or unsafe notification text.

assessment.overture-places: Best primary balance of open licensing, statewide breadth, consumer categories, stable IDs, and monthly refresh.
assessment.government-supplements: Best authoritative accuracy for civic, transportation, water, and infrastructure context, but layer-by-layer coverage varies.
assessment.commercial-fallback: Potentially improves closure history and commercial completeness if contract rights match Gridly requirements.
assessment.osm: Valuable community signal, but ODbL isolation and completeness variability prevent primary blended use.
